name: Kaushalya Logistics Ltd.
summary: Kaushalya Logistics Ltd. is an integrated multi-modal logistics solution provider primarily serving the cement industry across India. The company offers a range of services including clearing and forwarding, primary and secondary transportation, raw material transportation, 3PL services, warehouse management, manpower services, and rake clearance. It operates on an asset-light model, focusing on service delivery and supply chain management, and is a significant provider of logistics support to major cement manufacturers such as Dalmia Cement Bharat Limited. In addition to its core logistics operations, Kaushalya Logistics has diversified business interests in retail, operating as a diamond-category seller on a major online e-commerce platform for electronic and white goods, and managing a portfolio of commercial real estate properties in Udaipur, which are leased to retail tenants. The company continues to expand its national footprint to meet demand in infrastructure and construction sectors.
